## ПСБ Бизнес — Company.id 15762

Catalog metadata (unchanged):

```json
{
  "countryCode": "RU",
  "fullTitle": "\u041f\u0440\u043e\u043c\u0441\u0432\u044f\u0437\u044c\u0431\u0430\u043d\u043a",
  "id": 15762,
  "title": "\u041f\u0421\u0411 \u0411\u0438\u0437\u043d\u0435\u0441",
  "url": "business.psbank.ru"
}
```

Frozen base commit: `fe29fbc1291b8842ed201261408a3bc690875b55`. Checked: `2026-10-04T03:39:53.978215Z`.

### Exact versions and source

- Current/base SVG: [base.svg](https://github.com/zenmoney/banks/blob/1fbaa031031b17e72a64bb20b1e2002844aad5ff/review-materials/15762/base.svg) — SHA-256 `96a4262c9fa51764d088712b0a06c4008b9911e524a38f32f32ba6618d385bc3`.

- Proposed final SVG: [final.svg](https://github.com/zenmoney/banks/blob/1fbaa031031b17e72a64bb20b1e2002844aad5ff/review-materials/15762/final.svg) — SHA-256 `b5227af419151498ecd5488a031521737ef1b66916b9e41172491446ca13f7b6`.
- Generated VectorDrawable XML: [final.xml](https://github.com/zenmoney/banks/blob/1fbaa031031b17e72a64bb20b1e2002844aad5ff/review-materials/15762/final.xml) — SHA-256 `40783422b70b55a2f75076bf6f84ae1d335481a6323d7b607ed94b904ac5cdba`.
- Exact base-to-final changes: [candidate.diff](https://github.com/zenmoney/banks/blob/1fbaa031031b17e72a64bb20b1e2002844aad5ff/review-materials/15762/candidate.diff).
- Source page: [https://business.psbank.ru/assets/LogoPSBbussines\_f43f9bfa7097c3d3fc40.svg](https://business.psbank.ru/assets/LogoPSBbussines_f43f9bfa7097c3d3fc40.svg).
- Source asset: [https://business.psbank.ru/assets/LogoPSBbussines\_f43f9bfa7097c3d3fc40.svg](https://business.psbank.ru/assets/LogoPSBbussines_f43f9bfa7097c3d3fc40.svg).

### Evidence and judgment

- official checked 2026-10-04T03:24:00Z: [https://business.psbank.ru/](https://business.psbank.ru/). Business banking SPA references its logo assets including logo-on-white SVG; og:image points to the site logo. (independence group: official psbank.ru business site).
- official checked 2026-10-04T03:24:00Z: [https://business.psbank.ru/assets/LogoPSBbussines\_f43f9bfa7097c3d3fc40.svg](https://business.psbank.ru/assets/LogoPSBbussines_f43f9bfa7097c3d3fc40.svg); asset [https://business.psbank.ru/assets/LogoPSBbussines\_f43f9bfa7097c3d3fc40.svg](https://business.psbank.ru/assets/LogoPSBbussines_f43f9bfa7097c3d3fc40.svg). Direct original-vector lockup 140x24: pinwheel glyph \(orange #EA5616 + indigo #2C2D84, first two paths\) plus ПСБ \| Бизнес wordmark; no raster. (independence group: official psbank.ru business site).
- official checked 2026-10-04T03:24:00Z: [https://business.psbank.ru/assets/logo-on-white\_7203a90e8570648383de.svg](https://business.psbank.ru/assets/logo-on-white_7203a90e8570648383de.svg); asset [https://business.psbank.ru/assets/logo-on-white\_7203a90e8570648383de.svg](https://business.psbank.ru/assets/logo-on-white_7203a90e8570648383de.svg). Direct SVG of the same mark + ПСБ wordmark \(88x32\), corroborating the current mark design and colors. (independence group: official psbank.ru business site).
- Independent evidence: Two asset files from the same official host corroborate each other; main site brand page 403-blocked, disclosed..
- Identity: confirmed — Assets from the bank's own business.psbank.ru host for the ПСБ Бизнес service; fullTitle Промсвязьбанк is the operating bank \(renamed Банк ПСБ\)..
- Currency: confirmed — Live business.psbank.ru serves only the new orange/indigo mark on 2026-10-04; old blue mark absent from the site..
- Variant: confirmed — Standalone pinwheel glyph is the icon mark used beside the wordmark; transparent standalone paths; no circular avatar observation; no backing added..

Rationale: Evidenced rebrand: the operating brand serves the orange/indigo pinwheel mark \(business.psbank.ru\) while the catalog icon is the retired pre-rebrand blue ПСБ mark..
Role: standalone brand mark \(pinwheel glyph from the official lockup, wordmark excluded per catalog suitability\); variant: current flat two-color mark, transparent background preserved; no circular avatar observation, no backing added.
Visible difference: Evidenced rebrand: retired blue ПСБ-era icon replaced by the current two-color pinwheel used across the bank's live business service..
Details: Both pinwheel halves, their notches and colors match the official lockup mark exactly; no raster or recoloring involved.. Proportions: Square emblem fills the cell evenly at 240px and stays recognizable at small sizes on both themes..

Source-to-final transformations:
- viewBox narrowed to the mark bounds \(0 0 24 24\); only the two mark paths carried over; no scale/rotation/path edits
- SVGO 4.1.0 with the frozen repository svgo.config.mjs: 277→257 bytes; trial selected, renders verified identical to working on both themes

![Before and after — dark background](https://github.com/zenmoney/banks/blob/1fbaa031031b17e72a64bb20b1e2002844aad5ff/review-materials/15762/comparison-dark.png?raw=true)
